$comment: The Rush as cards (DECISIONS.md section D1636). A card is a wave model and a roll; packages/core/src/sim/rushCards.ts reads this file and says what each field does. waveModels[0] is the rush as it ran before cards and must not move: stored sittings and data/rush-house-runs.json are that rush. shape, mixes and beats are read only by scripts/generate-rush-wave-models.mjs, which writes each model's template into data/rush-wave-templates.json; run it after changing them. holdLine.people on every model but the climb, and the incident schedule, are TUNED and not cited: they were set so one dispatcher holds about as long under every model, and packages/viz/src/everyday/rushCardSpread.test.ts pins the spread they give.

waveModels.name: The Climb
waveModels.blurb: The plain ramp. Every wave is busier than the last, and no lift breaks down.

waveModels.name: Surges
waveModels.blurb: Every wave is a lull and then a crush. Lifts break down.
waveModels.shape: the climb in surges: every three-minute wave is a lull and then a crest, each wave bigger than the last

waveModels.name: Tides
waveModels.blurb: The crowd pours in at the lobby, then pours out of the floors, twice a wave. Lifts break down.
waveModels.shape: the climb with the tide turning: half of every wave pours in at the lobby and half pours out of the floors, each wave bigger than the last

waveModels.name: Crossfire
waveModels.blurb: Lunchtime. Most people are going between floors, in three pulses a wave. Lifts break down.
waveModels.shape: the climb at lunchtime: everybody is going between floors, in three quick pulses a wave, each wave bigger than the last

deck.title: The jumper
deck.text: A rider in {car} jumped just as it stopped, to see what would happen. What happened is a sprained ankle. {car} is out until the paramedics arrive, and the paramedics have taken {other} to get there.
deck.allClear: The jumper has been carried out, embarrassed. {car} and {other} are back.

deck.title: Sofa in the doors
deck.text: Two movers have wedged a sofa across the doors of {car}. They are discussing angles.
deck.allClear: The sofa is out. It went in sideways after all. {car} is back.

deck.title: Wedding photographs
deck.text: A wedding party is holding {car} for photographs. The photographer wants one more.
deck.allClear: The wedding party has left for the reception. {car} is back.

deck.title: The inspector is early
deck.text: The lift inspector has turned up a day early and has {car} on inspection.
deck.allClear: The inspector has signed off {car} and left a note about the carpet.

deck.title: Every button
deck.text: A toddler in {car} has pressed every button, the alarm included. Security is holding the car at the lobby until a parent turns up.
deck.allClear: A parent has turned up. {car} is back.

deck.title: Five-a-side
deck.text: A whole five-a-side team got into {car} at once and tripped the overload. It needs a reset.
deck.allClear: The team took the stairs. {car} is back.

deck.title: Coffee in the panel
deck.text: Somebody tipped a full coffee into the button panel of {car}. An engineer is drying it with a hair dryer.
deck.allClear: The panel is dry and smells of latte. {car} is back.

deck.title: Stuck between floors
deck.text: {car} has stopped between floors with six people in it. The engineer is using {other} alongside to get them out.
deck.allClear: Everybody is out and nobody is hurt. {car} and {other} are back.

deck.title: Pigeon
deck.text: There is a pigeon in {car}. Nobody will get in with it.
deck.allClear: The pigeon left by the lobby doors. {car} is back.

deck.title: Piano delivery
deck.text: A piano is being delivered, and the movers have {car} to themselves until it is upstairs.
deck.allClear: The piano is in. {car} is back.

deck.title: Power dip
deck.text: A dip in the supply tripped the drive on {car}. It is resetting itself.
deck.allClear: The drive has reset. {car} is back.

deck.title: The entourage
deck.text: A visiting chief executive’s security team has taken {car} for a private ride to the top.
deck.allClear: The chief executive has arrived. {car} is back.

deck.title: Key in the track
deck.text: A dropped key has jammed the door track of {car}. Facilities is fishing for it with a coat hanger.
deck.allClear: The key is out and the coat hanger is ruined. {car} is back.
